Color pink to pale pink with focal yellowish-white areas and small reddish spots
Surface texture irregular, bumpy/pebbly, moist and glistening
Broad-based attachment, margins not sharply demarcated in this view
No frank ulceration or active bleeding seen in this image, but surface appears uneven
Upper lip and anterior teeth partially visible; left buccal mucosa as reported not clearly visualized in this view
risk_factors: No tobacco, areca nut/supari, gutka, khaini, bidi/smoking, or alcohol habits reported in questionnaire

referral.confidence_note: A human clinician must confirm all observations in person.
referral.patient_summary_en: There is a large swelling seen on your lower lip that needs prompt checking by a specialist doctor in person. Please do not worry, but it is important to go for referral soon. A licensed clinician must examine you in person.
